standards.appliesTo: Eligible LMR areas in R1, R2, R3 and R4, where permitted; exclusions and other controls still need assessment.

references.title: NSW LMR — dual occupancy provisions
references.publisher: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure
references.locator: 2 dwellings on one lot; non-discretionary standards
references.evidence: R2 dual occupancies may seek development consent. Within eligible LMR areas, the summary lists 450 m², 12 m, 0.65:1 FSR, 9.5 m and one parking space per dwelling. These figures are conditional, not approval.
references.file: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure

references.title: NSW LMR — scope, maps and exclusions
references.publisher: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure
references.locator: Defining low and mid-rise housing areas; non-discretionary standards
references.evidence: Area checks use walking routes to nominated centres/stations, exclusions and TOD boundaries. Other applicable controls continue to matter. Meeting a non-refusal standard does not approve the whole proposal.
references.file: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure

references.title: NSW LMR — excluded land
references.publisher: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure
references.locator: Heritage items; aircraft noise; hazards; TOD areas
references.evidence: The guidance identifies land exclusions including heritage items, specified aircraft-noise contours, bushfire and specified flood/coastal hazards, and TOD areas. This is not a parcel assessment.
references.file: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure

references.title: Randwick LEP — Council overview and maps
references.locator: LEP overview; written instrument and map links
references.evidence: The LEP governs land use and mapped development controls. Check the actual parcel’s zoning, height, FSR, heritage and other constraints. The alias project address has not been mapped.

references.title: Randwick DCP — versions and transition
references.locator: Randwick DCP 2025; savings and transitional provisions
references.evidence: Council records Stage 2 commencing 27 July 2026. Some earlier undetermined applications have savings provisions, with stated exceptions for Housing SEPP affordable housing, co-living and LMR applications.

references.title: Randwick DCP C1 — low-density residential
references.evidence: C1 covers attached/detached dual occupancies and directs readers to relevant frontage, landscape, open-space, design and parking provisions. Its LMR relationship section must be checked before applying local controls.
references.version: Council-linked Stage 2 final PDF; footer retains Draft label. Reviewed section navigation only.

references.title: NSW Housing Pattern Book — approval pathways
references.publisher: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure
references.locator: Complying development for low-rise patterns; steps; relevant legislation
references.evidence: Eligible low-rise pattern designs may use complying development when all requirements are satisfied. Mid-rise patterns have a separate streamlined DA pathway. A pattern design does not remove site or application requirements.
references.file: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure

references.title: Low-Rise Housing Diversity Code — complying development
references.publisher: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure
references.evidence: The guidance describes complying development for eligible dual occupancies, manor houses and terraces, subject to code/design requirements and land-use permissibility. It does not confirm eligibility for this demo site.
references.file: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure
